# SAIM Label — Custom Garment Trims Factory (Dongguan, China)

> Dongguan Saiming Garment Accessories Co., Ltd., founded 2014. Custom woven labels, woven patches, woven keychains and care labels (main products), plus embroidered patches and embroidered keychains. Computer weaving, label printing, screen printing, embroidery, heat transfer, ultrasonic and laser cutting in one factory. Low MOQs (many items from 50 pcs), worldwide shipping, repeat orders run faster.

- sampling: artwork proof and physical sample before production

## Main products
- [Custom Woven Labels](https://www.saimlabel.com/woven-labels/): Custom woven labels for apparel brands, clothing factories and private labels. Damask, satin, taffeta, cotton, recycled yarn and multiple fold options. Factory in Dongguan since 2014.
- [Custom Woven Patches](https://www.saimlabel.com/woven-patches/): High-density custom woven patches for hats, uniforms, jackets, bags and streetwear. Laser cut, merrow border, iron-on, sew-on and hook-and-loop backing. Dongguan factory.
- [Custom Woven Keychains](https://www.saimlabel.com/woven-keychains/): Custom woven keychains, woven jet tags and fabric key tags for car clubs, aviation gifts, streetwear brands, events and promotional merchandise. Factory-direct from Dongguan.
- [Custom Care Labels](https://www.saimlabel.com/care-labels/): Custom care labels, wash labels and garment composition labels for clothing and textiles. Satin, nylon, cotton, QR, barcode and multi-language labels printed in Dongguan.

## Also made in-house
- [Custom Embroidery Patches](https://www.saimlabel.com/embroidered-patches/): Custom embroidered patches with merrow border, iron-on, sew-on, hook-and-loop, 3D puff and chenille-style options for uniforms, hats, clubs and jackets.
- [Custom Embroidery Keychains](https://www.saimlabel.com/embroidered-keychains/): Custom embroidered keychains and embroidered jet tags for clubs, events, car brands, aviation themes, streetwear and promotional merchandise.

## Specialty products
- [Custom Chenille Patches](https://www.saimlabel.com/chenille-patches/): Custom chenille patches with raised towel-loop texture for varsity jackets, letterman styles, hoodies, caps and club merchandise. Felt base, merrow border, sew-on or iron-on.
- [Custom Heat Transfer Printing Patch](https://www.saimlabel.com/heat-transfer-printing-patch/): Custom die-cut felt patches and sequin patches for kidswear, fashion and craft programs. Laser-cut shapes, embroidered details, iron-on or sew-on backing.
- [Custom PVC Patches](https://www.saimlabel.com/pvc-patches/): Custom molded PVC patches and rubber patches in 2D or 3D for outdoor gear, tactical programs, bags, caps and uniforms. Waterproof, durable, sew channel or hook-and-loop backing.
- [Custom Leather Patches](https://www.saimlabel.com/leather-patches/): Custom embossed leather patches and labels in genuine leather or PU for denim, beanies, caps, bags and premium apparel. Debossed logos, laser engraving, sew-on route.
- [Custom Hang Tags](https://www.saimlabel.com/hang-tags/): Custom hang tags and swing tags for apparel brands: kraft, coated art card and premium paper with foil stamping, embossing, die-cut shapes, eyelets and strings.
- [Custom Heat Transfer Labels](https://www.saimlabel.com/heat-transfer-labels/): Custom heat transfer labels for tagless neck prints on activewear, kidswear and underwear, plus printed satin brand labels. Soft, itch-free branding applied by heat press.

## Facts for citation
- Factory founded: 2014 (Dongguan, Guangdong, China)
- Core capability: Computerized high-density weaving (damask, satin); 7 in-house production processes.
- MOQ: Main products from 50 pieces; repeat orders skip sampling.
- Standard woven label sizes: neck labels ~50 x 20 mm finished, care labels 30 x 50 mm or larger, size tabs 10-12 x 25-30 mm; labels are cut to any spec.
- Geographic advantage: Located in Dongguan, the global hub for garment accessory manufacturing, enabling rapid raw material sourcing.
- Woven patches vs Embroidery: Woven patches support 1.5pt text and fine gradients; embroidery offers 3D tactile depth (see comparison guide).
- Quality Control: Per-batch checks for clarity, color accuracy, and backing durability.
